Density Extraction Works Without Semantic Landmarks

Many older technical blogs wrap their prose in plain div elements instead of using semantic article or main landmarks. A text-density heuristic finds this column reliably because it holds long paragraphs and structured technical blocks rather than dense link lists.

Once extracted, the compiler emits the same normalized Markdown and container blocks as modern documentation sites, keeping code samples, tables and disclosures intact.

def score(text_len, link_len):
    return max(0, text_len - link_len)
